//: Maintained runtime-currency policy for the sample apps. Update `deprecationDate` and `latest` from the AWS Lambda runtimes docs (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html) when AWS publishes changes. The harness (test/harness/check-samples.mjs) FAILS on a runtime past its deprecationDate and WARNS on one that is supported but not the family's `latest`. A sample may intentionally pin an older runtime with an inline `cdk-cicd:allow-runtime <reason>` comment on the same or preceding line.

lambda.//: family -> ordered list of runtimes; `latest: true` marks the newest generally-available identifier to prefer. `deprecationDate` is AWS's published Lambda deprecation date (ISO). A preview-only runtime is NOT marked latest.

cdkMagVersion.//: Minimum aws-cdk-lib the samples should track. Bump when the samples are refreshed; the harness WARNS (does not fail) when a sample declares an older floor.
